classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary One card of a board: the component of one record, rendered from the board's card items, with inline title
 * editing and the menu button that opens the board's shared {@link Neo.board.CardEditor}.
 * @description Render-all columns keep the instance for the record's life; sliced columns create visible cards and
 * retain only a bounded offscreen set. `board.getCard` returns null offscreen in sliced mode; `column.scrollToRecord`
 * renders the requested record again. Its id derives from the board and the record key (`<board>__card__<key>`), so a
 * whitebox test or an agent resolves it without an index. The record's `color` paints `--neo-board-card-accent`; the rest
 * is the items' work ({@link Neo.board.CardItems}).
 *
 * Double-clicking `.neo-board-card-title` or pressing `F2` on a focused card replaces the title node with a
 * `Neo.form.field.Text` (`neo-board-card-inline-editor`): `Enter` or blur commits `record.set({title})` when the
 * value changed, while `Escape` restores the title node without writing. Clicking `.neo-board-card-menu-button` or
 * pressing `Enter` on the focused card opens the board's shared {@link Neo.board.CardEditor}.
 * @class Neo.board.Card
 * @extends Neo.component.Base
 */
classData.summary:
One card of a board: the component of one record, rendered from the board's card items, with inline title
editing and the menu button that opens the board's shared {@link Neo.board.CardEditor}.
classData.description:
Render-all columns keep the instance for the record's life; sliced columns create visible cards and retain only a bounded offscreen set. board.getCard returns null offscreen in sliced mode; column.scrollToRecord renders the requested record again. Its id derives from the board and the record key (<board>__card__<key>), so a whitebox test or an agent resolves it without an index. The record's color paints --neo-board-card-accent; the rest is the items' work ({@link Neo.board.CardItems}).

Double-clicking .neo-board-card-title or pressing F2 on a focused card replaces the title node with a Neo.form.field.Text (neo-board-card-inline-editor): Enter or blur commits record.set({title}) when the value changed, while Escape restores the title node without writing. Clicking .neo-board-card-menu-button or pressing Enter on the focused card opens the board's shared {@link Neo.board.CardEditor}.
classData.name: Card
